theorems.name: Submission.exists_separated_finset_subset_cover_closedBall
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [PseudoMetricSpace X] (K : Set X) (r : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 ≤ r → (∀ F : Finset X, (↑F : Set X) ⊆ K → (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) → F.card ≤ N) → ∃ F : Finset X, (↑F : Set X) ⊆ K ∧ (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ F, closedBall x r
